name: candlestick-chart
title: Candlestick Chart
description: Financial and telemetry OHLC candlestick chart with high/low wicks, bullish/bearish chassis bodies, integrated volume histogram, and hover crosshair.

props.name: data
props.description: Array of OHLC candle points with time, open, high, low, close, and volume

props.name: height
props.description: Height of SVG charting canvas in pixels

props.name: showVolume
props.description: Renders proportional volume histogram bars at bottom of canvas

examples.title: Financial Telemetry Stream
examples.description: Real-time OHLC candlestick price action with volume bars and floating inspection HUD.
